metadata.purpose: Original learnsets before native HM injections; candidate design input, not ROM output.
metadata.content_switches: All HAS_*_CONTENT=0 restores baseline; all family/form switches=1 inventories candidates.
metadata.compatibility: all_learnables.json any supported game/method plus original level-up utility moves; not a promise of active TM availability.
metadata.species_mapping: Explicit species_info modern pointers; Gen3 table fallback for shared form macros (flagged).
metadata.encounters: Use coverage.py; inventory itself includes unencountered and disabled species/forms.
metadata.order: Learnset source order preserved, including original duplicate moves and level 0 evolution entries.
